# The Queen Dairy Menu

> An independent, fan-maintained culinary and price guide for the Dairy Queen® menu.

## About This Site
The Queen Dairy Menu (thequeendairymenu.us) provides an unofficial, comprehensive overview of the Dairy Queen menu, featuring estimated 2026 prices, calorie counts, nutrition insights, and ordering advice. 

This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Dairy Queen®, International Dairy Queen, Inc., or Berkshire Hathaway Inc. All prices are estimates based on national averages; local franchise prices may vary.
